_comment: Type-check configuration of the Web_App. There is no tsconfig.build.json counterpart as in apps/api: Vite performs the transpilation, so tsc only ever type-checks. The generated src/routeTree.gen.ts is part of the program on purpose — it is what makes a wrong route path a type error. The E2E suite under e2e/ is included as well: Playwright transpiles its specs without type-checking them, so `pnpm check-types` is the only thing that would catch a page object whose locator method no longer exists.
